translations.web: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.”
translations.bsb: Yet I sent you all My servants the prophets again and again, saying: ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate.’
translations.kjv: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
